aiResearchSummary.text: General Radar Corp. is engaged in developing multi-purpose radar systems featuring electronically steered transmit/receive elements and digital signal processing, as described in Multi-purpose radar system. Their work also includes compact analog beamformers and microwave radar systems with linear antenna arrays and Rotman lenses, as detailed in Compact analog beamformers and microwave radar systems containing the same. These efforts focus on high resolution mm-wave radar technologies for automotive applications.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $22,000,000, or 81.91% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $15,859,182 to $113,114,789, a 7.13x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
